H6IN07444.name: Patrick McAuley
H6IN07444.bio: Lifelong Indianapolis resident and young professional with a master's degree in international economics and finance and previous experience in the U.S. Senate.

positions.stance: Will push for stronger community-police relationships, more officers living and working in the same precincts, and targeted resources that reduce crime.
Will fight to expand housing supply, convert vacant properties into productive use, and support practical pathways off the street through partnerships and federal resources.
"Not every young person needs a four-year degree"; will prioritize expanded trades, apprenticeships, and skilled-job opportunities for Indianapolis residents.

H4IN08249.name: Mark Messmer
H4IN08249.bio: Southern Indiana small business owner who has served in the Indiana Statehouse.

H6IN08293.name: Mary Allen
H6IN08293.bio: Evansville at-large city councilor and small business owner.

positions.stance: "Healthcare is a human right"; will fight to protect and expand Medicaid and Medicare and ensure rural hospitals can keep serving Hoosier communities.
Supports investing in homes for working families, expanding affordable housing programs, and removing tariffs on food and other essentials to lower costs.
Supports a national minimum wage tied to inflation, protecting the right to join a union, paid time off, and affordable community college and apprenticeships.
Supports federal support for local child care centers, ensuring no family pays more than 7% of income for child care, and universal pre-K.
Will fight for full funding for schools, a living wage for teachers, and protecting the Department of Education.

H6IN09143.name: Erin Houchin
H6IN09143.bio: Member of the U.S. House for Indiana's 9th District and former Indiana state senator.

positions.stance: Supports President Trump's border efforts, "backing law enforcement, finishing the wall, and deporting criminal illegal aliens."
Stands firmly with Israel and supports cutting all U.S. aid to any sponsors of terrorism.
Believes the federal government should balance its budget as families do, calling the growing national debt a national security concern.
"Erin is pro-life and always has been"; advocates prohibiting late-term abortions and providing resources and care for mothers in need.
Describes herself as a strong defender of the Second Amendment, the right to life, and the right to worship freely, supporting an America First agenda.

H6IN09242.name: Brad Meyer
H6IN09242.bio: Former Navy civilian engineer who spent nine years working in electromagnetic warfare at Naval Surface Warfare Center, Crane.

positions.stance: Will fight to end policies that keep people living paycheck to paycheck, holding corporations accountable and making strategic public investments.
Says "Medicare for All is a proven solution" to guarantee coverage for every resident and end medical bankruptcies.
Will stand up for the courts, equal justice, and civil liberties, saying laws and institutions "must serve the Constitution, not one person's ambition."
Will fight efforts to dismantle public education and supports the Department of Education's role in protecting student rights.
Supports clean energy, fair rules, and public oversight to hold polluters responsible for pollution of Indiana's rivers and air.

H8MD01094.name: Andy Harris
H8MD01094.bio: Physician, former Naval Reserve commander, and former Maryland state senator serving as U.S. Representative for Maryland's 1st District.

H6MD01320.name: Dan Schwartz
H6MD01320.bio: Consumer watchdog who has worked with state banking regulators and the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau to protect consumers from financial fraud.

positions.stance: Promises monthly town halls and supports ending costly tariffs, restoring funding for district projects, and improving health care access in MD-1.
Supports raising the federal minimum wage, repealing cuts to Medicaid, Medicare and SNAP, and allowing public option plans in the ACA marketplace.
Supports codifying Roe v. Wade in federal law and passing bipartisan immigration reform that protects asylum seekers and secures the borders.
Supports banning members of Congress and the executive branch from trading stocks and crypto, ending Citizens United, and reining in presidential pardon power.
Supports restoring Consumer Financial Protection Bureau staff, protecting the right to unionize, and making wage theft a crime.

H4MD02232.name: Johnny Olszewski
H4MD02232.bio: U.S. Representative for Maryland's 2nd District since 2025; former public-school teacher, Maryland delegate, and Baltimore County Executive.

positions.stance: Pushing for higher wages, affordable health care, and fully funded public schools, and defending SNAP, Medicare, and Social Security.
Supports extending health-insurance tax credits, ending Trump-era tariffs, reining in prescription drug costs, expanding housing supply, and cutting utility bills.
Supports extending ACA tax credits, more aggressive Medicare drug price negotiation, capping out-of-pocket costs, and safeguarding reproductive health care.
Supports legislation to expand voting rights, protect court independence, prevent presidential abuses, and ban stock trading by members of Congress.
Supports converting vacant buildings into affordable homes, tax incentives for first-time homebuyers, small-dollar mortgages, and reducing tariffs on construction materials.

H2MD06138.name: Dave Wallace
H2MD06138.bio: Maryland businessman who entered his family business in 1981 and has worked with Restore America's Mission and the FAIR Energy Foundation.

positions.stance: Will protect police and other first responders and vote to give them the resources and equipment they need.
Says the fentanyl epidemic must be confronted, calling for drug courts and counseling services.
Will introduce and be lead sponsor of the Gold Standard Act to restore the gold standard and "end inflation in its tracks."
Will fight for lower gas prices and energy independence, using energy sources wherever they are, "including natural gas in Maryland."
Will fight for younger people's right to invest their Social Security in 401Ks.

H4MD03156.name: Sarah Elfreth
H4MD03156.bio: U.S. Representative for Maryland's 3rd District and former Maryland state senator.

positions.stance: Has worked to revoke the President's tariffs, expand affordable child care, reduce student loan burdens, build more housing, and roll back BG&E rate increases.
Fighting for a clean energy future, climate resilience, and expanded access to the Chesapeake Bay.
Has fought for oversight and accountability of ICE and "refused to fund a DHS and ICE that has been weaponized by this President."
Has introduced and co-sponsored bills to strengthen protections for civil servants, including legislation to protect the civil service from DOGE.
Supports investing in the Port, supporting affected workers and businesses, and working with the Maryland delegation to rebuild the Key Bridge.

H4MD03149.name: Berney Flowers
H4MD03149.bio: Retired U.S. Air Force lieutenant colonel and former Department of Defense civil servant who helped launch U.S. Cyber Command.

positions.stance: Advocates for term limits.
Advocates for fiscal responsibility.
Champions education reform.
Champions infrastructure renewal.

H2MD04232.name: Glenn Ivey
H2MD04232.bio: Member of Congress; former Prince George's County State's Attorney, assistant U.S. Attorney, and chair of Maryland's Public Service Commission.

positions.stance: Teaming up with unions, advocacy groups, and attorneys in the courts and Congress to fight what he calls unlawful attacks on federal workers.

H6MD05321.name: Adrian Boafo
H6MD05321.bio: Maryland state delegate, former Bowie City Council member and Mayor Pro Tem, and former staffer for Congressman Steny Hoyer.

positions.stance: Supports raising the federal minimum wage to $15 tied to inflation, cutting taxes for working families, protecting the Child Tax Credit, and universal child care.
Supports overturning Citizens United, banning congressional stock trading, and passing the Equality Act and John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act.
Supports increasing teacher pay, universal child care and early childhood education, and increased Title I funding.
Fighting to make Maryland a leader in clean energy, hold big polluters accountable, protect the Chesapeake Bay, and lower energy costs.
Fighting to protect the more than 75,000 federal workers in Maryland's Fifth District; "I will always stand in their defense."

H4MD05169.name: Chris Chaffee
H4MD05169.bio: Builder, home improvement contractor, and farmer who started a home building business in 1991.

positions.stance: "I will fight to bring resources home to support District 5."
Criticizes delays in rebuilding Baltimore's Key Bridge and supports studying a new bridge crossing from Calvert to St. Mary's County.
Pledges to term-limit himself at three terms.
Says housing costs have skyrocketed and "we need to minimize the permit process for both residential and commercial construction."
"No legislators should be paid if the budget isn't balanced this should be the law."

H4MD06340.name: April McClain Delaney
H4MD06340.bio: Communications lawyer and former Deputy Assistant Secretary for Communications at the U.S. Department of Commerce; former Washington director of Common Sense Media.

positions.stance: Committed to addressing rising costs, protecting health care, and ensuring children have access to equal, high-quality education.
Will champion innovation, support small businesses and local entrepreneurs, and invest in job training programs to strengthen the workforce.
Plans to leverage technology and broadband access to drive economic development across the 6th District.
Believes "we need to rebuild trust in our Democracy" and will "champion progress over partisanship."

H6MD06287.name: Robin Ficker
H6MD06287.bio: Business owner and farm owner who served in the Maryland legislature.

positions.stance: Will work to slash wasteful spending, reduce the federal deficit, and restore sanity to the budget process.
Will support police, hold criminals accountable, and fight against soft-on-crime policies.
Will champion lower taxes, fewer regulations, and pro-growth policies to create jobs in America rather than overseas.
Strongly opposes annexing the District of Columbia into Maryland and "will fight to keep D.C. and Maryland separate."
"Only American citizens should vote in American elections"; opposes allowing non-citizens to vote.

H6MD07020.name: Kweisi Mfume
H6MD07020.bio: Former member of Congress, Baltimore City Council member, and president and CEO of the NAACP.

H0MD02255.name: Scott Collier
H0MD02255.bio: Community and disability advocate in Maryland.

positions.stance: Wants to work with District 7 citizens "to turn the tide on crime, gangs, educational issues & the out of control drug problems."
Lists "putting an end to food deserts in our communities" as a priority.
Will continue working with law enforcement and groups that support officers to make communities safer.
"I do believe that democracy is on the ballot and so are our freedoms."
Opposes additional military assistance for Ukraine and says he "will fight to restore peace in the Middle East and also in Ukraine."

H6MD08457.name: Jamie Raskin
H6MD08457.bio: U.S. Representative for Maryland's 8th District since 2017; former constitutional law professor and Maryland state senator.

positions.stance: "When I'm in Congress, I'll fight to make sure Marylanders, especially the most vulnerable members of our community, are safe and sound."
Will push for "pro-growth business policies that protect American workers and put American businesses first."
Will focus on keeping "Communist policies" out and promoting "freedom and liberty for all."
Says America First means sealed borders, unleashed energy for jobs and lower costs, and parents' rights in education.
Will defend the Constitution, the Second Amendment, veterans, and law enforcement.

H4MO01134.name: Wesley Bell
H4MO01134.bio: U.S. Representative for Missouri's 1st District since 2024; former public defender, professor, judge, and prosecutor.

positions.stance: Fighting to bring federal resources home, including funding for housing, Lambert Airport modernization, Coldwater Creek compensation, and tornado recovery.
Supports federal relief for energy costs, cracking down on price gouging, capping drug prices, and making higher education affordable.
"Wesley believes ICE needs to be stripped for parts," and ICE agents who broke the law should be fully prosecuted.
Strongly supports making the John Lewis Voting Rights Act law to fight voter suppression.
Supports codifying abortion rights at the federal level so everyone can access necessary health care regardless of state.

H2MO02102.name: Ann Wagner
H2MO02102.bio: U.S. Representative for Missouri's 2nd District; former manager at Hallmark Cards and Ralston-Purina.

positions.stance: Works to cut taxes and eliminate burdensome regulations so local businesses can grow and create jobs.
Authored the Fight Online Sex Trafficking Act and secured funding for rape kit testing through the Debbie Smith Act.
Voted for the Working Families Tax Cut, including removing taxes on tips, overtime, and Social Security.
Has worked to defend the right to life and introduced the Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act.
Supports building the wall at the southern border and holding violent criminals accountable.

H6MO02343.name: Fred Wellman
H6MO02343.bio: Army veteran, West Point graduate and former Army aviator, and entrepreneur.

positions.stance: Supports lowering costs, expanding access to good-paying jobs, and making sure every family can afford housing, health care, child care, and groceries.
Supports immediately raising the federal minimum wage, protecting the right to unionize, equal pay, paid family leave, and ending illegal union-busting.
Supports protecting Social Security and Medicare, defending pensions, and strengthening retirement benefits.
Supports restoring ACA subsidies, reversing Medicaid cuts, lowering the Medicare eligibility age, and a strong public option, with universal coverage as the goal.

H2MO03167.name: Bethany Mann
H2MO03167.bio: Chemist who began her career as an intern with the Environmental Protection Agency and works on agricultural and environmental testing.

positions.stance: Supports full and equal funding for public education, from pre-K through higher education and union apprenticeships.
Calls for accessible, affordable health care, including mental health, and support for patients, first responders, and health care workers.
Supports securing Missouri's fair share of federal infrastructure investments and extending them to rural areas.
Committed to clean air and water, preparation for extreme weather, and jobs in renewable energy.
Supports removing barriers to voting and expanding the ways eligible voters can participate in elections.

H8MO09146.name: Bob Onder
H8MO09146.bio: Physician and attorney serving in Congress since 2024; former Missouri state representative and state senator.

positions.stance: Introduced the "Timely Departure Act" to crack down on visa overstays.
Co-chairman of the Pro-Life Caucus who has introduced the Child Interstate Abortion Notification Act and the Dismemberment Abortion Ban.
Led passage of Constitutional Carry and the Second Amendment Preservation Act in the Missouri Senate.
Supported the Working Families Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, making permanent what he calls the largest tax cuts in American history.
Leads the Chloe Cole Act to end transgender surgeries on minors, and opposes teaching Critical Race Theory in public schools.

H2MO04207.name: Mark Alford
H2MO04207.bio: U.S. Representative for Missouri's 4th District; former Kansas City morning news anchor for 25 years.

positions.stance: "I am 100% Pro-Life. I will always staunchly defend the right to life and protect the rights of the unborn."
"I will always fight tirelessly to ensure that no one infringes upon our Second Amendment rights."
Wants primary education handled by states and localities and opposes federal overreach in classrooms.
Will work to maintain U.S. military dominance and deter what he calls the pacing threat from China.
Supports implementing term limits to eliminate career politicians; cosponsored term limit legislation his first week in Congress and "pledge[s] to always support term limits."
